title: Special repairs and maintenance of Officers colony, Lambaline.
summary: E-tender (percentage rate) for special repairs and maintenance of the DLL officers' colony at Lambaline, Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman & Nicobar Islands (Port Blair / Sri Vijaya Puram Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair)

sites.name: Officers colony, Lambaline, Sri Vijaya Puram
sites.work: Special repairs and maintenance of officers' colony

scope.item: Special repairs and maintenance of Officers colony, Lambaline

money.notes: EMD by Deposit at Call Receipt/FDR of any RBI-approved nationalised/scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Sri Vijay Puram, payable at Sri Vijay Puram; valid 06 months from technical bid opening; originals with technical documents by registered/speed post or in person; MSME/NSIC registration for similar work eligible for EMD exemption. Bid document free of cost.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Eligible experienced civil contractors who have successfully completed similar work of 'Construction/maintenance of Buildings in Andaman & Nicobar Island' with Government organisations and have no adverse remarks
Detailed eligibility as per Section-III clause 3.1 (not included)
Near relatives posted as accountant or gazetted officer in DGLL/MoPSW bar participation (standard clause)
notes: Section I NIT only (printed pages 4-6); no BOQ. Bid download/submission 30.05.2025 18:00 to 10.06.2025 15:00; technical bid opening 10.06.2025 15:00 (subject to internet availability), yet last date for original EMD is 11.06.2025 15:00, after bid opening. Listing gives end 2025-06-10 and opening 2025-06-11.
